body: @pugnascotia looks like the `createLink` method on `QuotaAwareFileSystemProvider` need to also unwrap its paths for the hard linking to work.

issue.title: Fix missing `QuotaPath.unwrap()` instances

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Closes #67164. There were a couple of places in
`QuotaAwareFileSystemProvider` where the supplied paths were not being
unwrapped back into platform-specific path objects.
